description.value: Hurford Hill Nature Park is a 10.7-hectare urban nature reserve donated to the City of Courtenay in 1996 and protected in perpetuity by the Comox Valley Land Trust. It forms a critical link along the Valley View Greenway and shelters native species alongside Glen Urquhart Creek's salmon habitat. Cycling is explicitly encouraged within the park, making it a worthwhile green-space stop for cyclists travelling the Comox Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The CVLT website confirms Hurford Hill Nature Park is an active public nature park owned by the City of Courtenay, protected in perpetuity by a conservation covenant. The page explicitly states 'cycling is encouraged' and notes street parking along Hurford Avenue, Glen Urquhart Drive, and Hobson Avenue — but no bike racks, water sources, or washroom facilities are mentioned anywhere in the content. No phone number or civic address appear in OSM or on the website page.
concerns: No civic address recorded in OSM or on website — only informal street-parking references.
No phone number available in OSM or on website; the listing page belongs to the land trust steward (CVLT), not the park operator (City of Courtenay).
Website counter widgets display '0 Hectares' and '0 Year Donated', suggesting a rendering/JavaScript issue that may affect data completeness.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The park is a legitimate cycling-friendly attraction on the Valley View Greenway, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) are unconfirmed — the website mentions no on-site facilities. A site visit or direct contact with the City of Courtenay parks department would be needed to verify whether any infrastructure exists before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Park is managed by the City of Courtenay; the CVLT website is the stewardship/conservation-covenant holder, not the operational contact. Cycling is explicitly encouraged per the CVLT page.

wow_evidence: 10.7-ha land-trust-protected urban reserve where cycling is explicitly encouraged; greenway link.
blurb: Nature park on Courtenay's Valley View Greenway; cycling welcome.
